issue.title: Vault AGENTS.md still says the vault is actively synced by Obsidian Sync
issue.description: Line 5 of ~/bob/AGENTS.md (CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, QWEN.md, OPENCODE.md are @AGENTS.md shims) reads 'This repository is an Obsidian vault that is actively synced by Obsidian Sync.' Obsidian Sync is retired; bob vault-sync (git) is the only active engine (bob-vault-sync.service on athena/apollo, com.bbugyi.bob-vault-sync on the Mac). The surrounding guidance (inspect git status, don't revert unrelated changes, commit only your files) is still right; only the engine name and rationale should change to git sync, ideally pointing at bob vault-sync status --json. Root cause is precise: one stale sentence from commit 9df5ce48 (2026-05-30), written before the git-sync cutover.

task_type_fields.impact: Agents working in the vault get a wrong mental model of how changes propagate (Obsidian Sync vs git auto-commit/push), which matters for conflict handling and for _conflicts/ recovery. Low severity.
task_type_fields.repro: grep -n 'Obsidian Sync' ~/bob/AGENTS.md  # -> 5: ...actively synced by Obsidian Sync...

issue.creation_reason: Found while researching qmd vault search: agents entering ~/bob read instructions naming a retired sync engine, which contradicts the obsidian.md memory and docs/vault-git-sync.md.
